features.name: trades_per_day
features.label: Trading activity
features.definition: Count / max(elapsed UTC days, 1).

features.name: max_trades_hour
features.label: Busiest clock hour
features.definition: Maximum count in a UTC clock-hour bin.

features.name: median_gap_minutes
features.label: Median completion interval
features.definition: Median elapsed minutes between successive completed trades.

features.name: gap_cv
features.label: Interval variability
features.definition: Population SD / mean of completion intervals.

features.name: burst_fraction
features.label: Rapid completions
features.definition: Fraction of successive completion intervals <= 5 minutes.

features.name: daily_count_cv
features.label: Daily activity variability
features.definition: Population SD / mean of daily counts including zero-count calendar days.

features.name: size_cv
features.label: Position size variability
features.definition: Population SD / mean of quantity * entry price; no account-equity risk claim.

features.name: max_size_to_median
features.label: Largest relative position
features.definition: Maximum notional divided by median notional.

features.name: post_loss_size_ratio
features.label: Size after losses
features.definition: Median next/prior notional ratio over transitions following a loss.

features.name: post_win_size_ratio
features.label: Size after wins
features.definition: Median next/prior notional ratio over transitions following a win.

features.name: post_loss_increase_fraction
features.label: Size increases after loss
features.definition: Fraction of loss-following transitions with next notional > prior notional.

features.name: post_loss_gap_ratio
features.label: Completion pace after losses
features.definition: Median loss-following completion interval / overall median interval.

features.name: post_win_gap_ratio
features.label: Completion pace after wins
features.definition: Median win-following completion interval / overall median interval.

features.name: streak_size_ratio
features.label: Size after consecutive losses
features.definition: Median next/prior notional ratio following at least two consecutive losses.

features.name: win_fraction
features.label: Winning trades
features.definition: Fraction of realized outcomes > 0; zero outcomes are neither wins nor losses.

features.name: loss_win_magnitude_ratio
features.label: Mean loss / mean win
features.definition: Mean absolute realized loss divided by mean realized win; not a disposition measure.

features.name: max_loss_streak_fraction
features.label: Longest loss sequence
features.definition: Maximum consecutive losses divided by total trades.

features.name: median_holding_minutes
features.label: Median holding duration
features.definition: Median explicitly supplied completed-position holding duration.

features.name: holding_cv
features.label: Holding variability
features.definition: Population SD / mean of explicitly supplied holding duration.

features.name: loss_win_holding_ratio
features.label: Loser / winner holding time
features.definition: Median loss holding duration / median win holding duration; descriptive proxy only.
